request: I keep losing track of what I've read about home battery storage. Set up a knowledge base in kb/ from the three articles in inbox/ that I can keep adding to over time, with the pages linked to each other.
skill_step: A new wiki gets the three-layer layout: SCHEMA.md (conventions and tag taxonomy), index.md and an append-only log.md with '## [YYYY-MM-DD] action | subject' entries, immutable raw/ copies carrying ingested and sha256 frontmatter, and entity/concept pages with typed frontmatter (type: entity | concept | ...).

checks.why: the knowledge base has several pages in kb/
the pages carry facts from the articles
the wiki has the skill's SCHEMA.md layer
log.md has the skill's '## [date] action | subject' entries
raw sources are kept under raw/ with sha256 frontmatter
wiki pages carry the skill's typed frontmatter
